messages:
IncidentBot: Alert triggered: spike in routing failures for smart-routing policy 'customer-default-v2' across eu-west-1 -> multiple fallbacks observed, threshold breached (error-rate 12%, failover loops). Pager notified: Marta (oncall).

Marta (oncall): seeing repeated logs: 'variant-mismatch: resolved variant xyz -> fallback a -> fallback b -> retry xyz' — looks like flip-flopping. Paging Priya and Samir. @Priya can you confirm SLO impact? :loud_sound:

Priya (SRE): confirmed — latency SLOs degraded for a subset of customers (p95 tokens +75%). Affected requests show repeated policy re-eval within 2s. Might be policy resolution oscillation.

Samir (eng): digging into routing-service logs. Early hypothesis: recent configschema rollout removed 'preferred_variant' but we still have old configs with that field present for some tenants. New resolver treats unknown field as 'use-default' which is a no-op and then fallback rules kick in.

Alex P (platform): I rolled the schema conversion last night (deploy 2024-11-07 02:13 UTC). There was a migration that maps old keys but it intentionally drops deprecated keys. Did we miss a compatibility shim?

Samir (eng): 1) grabbing example request trace. 2) extracting policy blob connected to tenant A.

Samir (eng): snippet of the stored config we fetched: ```json
{"region_policy":"legacy_failover","preferred_variant":"gpt-small-quant","fallback_order":["gpt-medium","gpt-small","gpt-legacy"]}
```

Samir (eng): after the schema change, the resolver now treats unknown enum 'legacy_failover' as null. Runtime then falls back to computed policy which adds region-based failover then a variant remap. That remap regenerates a policy that references the deprecated 'preferred_variant' key again in a transient path, causing the resolver to alternate between two implementations.

Marta (oncall): customers impacted: Julia, can you check which customer tickets are inflight and severity?

Julia (Support): I see 3 P1s from two large customers: retail-corp + fintech-chi. They report timeouts and increased cost due to retries. Noted elevated churn risk. Communicating mitigation to them now.

Priya (SRE): Mitigation plan (short): 1) pause config-schema enforcement for 'routing-resolver' traffic (route to pre-change binary) 2) temporarily disable fallback cycling by adding keepalive TTL on policy cache 3) patch migration to preserve deprecated key mapping.

Alex P (platform): Can we do 1 quickly? Deploying a rollback to the resolver will take ~12min + traffic drain. I can initiate a canary to 10% first.

Marta (oncall): Do 10% now. Also add a temporary feature-flag to short-circuit fallback if it detects reentry within 3s. That avoids oscillation at least.

Samir (eng): starting a hotfix branch, will push mapping shim to treat missing 'preferred_variant' by inferring from 'fallback_order[0]' and mark config as migrated. Patch ready, need approval to deploy to production.

Ben (Product Ops): we need a single unified comms line for customers — summary + ETA. Julia, draft a short note: root cause + temporary workaround + ETA for full fix.

Julia (Support): drafting now. ETA for workaround = 30m (feature flag + canary). ETA for full fix = 3h (migration + verification).

IncidentBot: Pager update: escalation to oncall lead in 10m.

Priya (SRE): rolling out shortcut: ```bash
# apply feature flag to routing-resolver fleet
curl -X POST https://ops-api/featureset/apply -d '{"feature":"fallback-oscillation-guard","enable":true,"threshold_ms":3000}'
```

Priya (SRE): feature flag applied to control plane. Starting resolver canary rollback to pre-schema binary on 10% of routing nodes. Monitoring for error-rate change.

Samir (eng): hotfix patch deployed to 20% canary (packages pushed). Logs show canary nodes no longer entering the loop. Error-rate on canary down to 1.2%.

Marta (oncall): increase canary to 50% and monitor for 5m. If stable, full rollout.

Priya (SRE): canary at 50% -> stable for 6m -> begin full roll to 100% (completed at +37m). Error-rate back to baseline, p95 latency recovered.

Samir (eng): deploying migration patch now to convert any lingering configs: transform rule: if 'preferred_variant' exists, populate new 'variant_hint' and remove deprecated enum mapping. Migration script: ```python
# migration snippet
for cfg in configs_with_deprecated_key:
    cfg['variant_hint'] = cfg.get('preferred_variant') or cfg.get('fallback_order', [None])[0]
    cfg.pop('preferred_variant', None)
    write_back(cfg)
```

Samir (eng): migration ran and updated ~114 tenant configs. No schema conflicts found in dry-run.

Marta (oncall): handoff to Priya for postmortem and long-term remediation. Priya, flagging follow-ups: 1) stricter schema compatibility tests in deploy pipeline 2) add automatic revert threshold for routing-resolver 3) customer-facing RCA draft.

Priya (SRE): noted. Creating incident ticket INC-2024-1884. Assigned follow-ups to Samir (migration validation), Alex P (deploy gating), Ben (customer comms).

Julia (Support): sent customer updates to retail-corp and fintech-chi: short summary + workaround + apology. Both acknowledged and monitoring.

Ben (Product Ops): customer impact estimate: ~0.6% of traffic (heavy-weight customers), revenue exposure low but SLA blips for two accounts. Recommending operational credit as goodwill.

Marta (oncall): retrospective quick notes: root cause = schema rewrite that changed handling of deprecated enum + missing mapping shim -> runtime interpreted null -> dual-path resolver created oscillation. Immediate fix = rollback + feature flag to guard oscillation. Permanent fix = migration + stronger pre-deploy contract tests.

Priya (SRE): closing timeline: incident opened 1751239876 -> mitigation started +18m -> full rollback + global fix at +37m -> migration + verification complete +2h50m. I'll attach monitoring graphs and traces to the incident ticket.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Postmortem requested by system. :white_check_mark:

Marta (oncall): thanks team. Assigning postmortem write-up to Samir and Priya.

Samir (eng): will prepare detailed RCA and include snippets of resolver decision traces and config diffs.

Julia (Support): following up with customers in 1h with full update.

Ben (Product Ops): action: evaluate credit offer and coordinate with finance.

Priya (SRE): leaving this in the 'incidents' channel for visibility. If anyone notices residual issues, ping me directly.

Marta (oncall): handing off to Priya (SRE) for overnight watch. Signing off. :wave:
